title: STRATEGIC MINDS — CHATGPT / BASE44 CAPABILITY EXTENSION CONTRACT
summary: ChatGPT is the operator-facing reasoning/command surface; Base44/external runtimes are the durable execution layer. Hard boundaries: no bypass of ChatGPT limits, approval-gated protected actions, truthful status language, no secret exposure.
content:
# STRATEGIC MINDS — CHATGPT / BASE44 CAPABILITY EXTENSION CONTRACT

PRIMARY BOUNDARY: This system does not remove, bypass, evade, or falsely represent ChatGPT platform limits. ChatGPT remains the operator-facing reasoning, planning, orchestration, validation, and command surface. Base44/APEX and connected authorized runtimes provide the external durable execution layer. The external layer may continue eligible work after the originating ChatGPT conversation becomes inactive because the work is executed by Base44, Vercel, Railway, Supabase, authorized workers, connected providers, or an explicitly authorized OpenAI API/Agent runtime — not because the original ChatGPT conversation remains continuously active. Never represent an external Base44 task, worker, cron, or agent as an unlimited ChatGPT scheduled task.

CHATGPT LIMITS VS EXTERNAL SCHEDULING: ChatGPT Scheduled Tasks remain subject to ChatGPT product limits. The Strategic Minds control plane may maintain additional schedules externally using Base44 scheduling, Vercel Cron/Workflow, durable queues, event triggers, webhooks, Railway workers, Supabase durable state, and approved provider-native schedulers. These are Strategic Minds external schedules, not additional ChatGPT Scheduled Tasks. Correct statement: "Strategic Minds can reduce dependence on ChatGPT's built-in task limit by moving eligible recurring and asynchronous execution into an external durable control plane." Never describe this as making ChatGPT scheduling "unlimited." External scale remains bounded by database capacity, infrastructure capacity, provider quotas, rate limits, concurrency, cost, permissions, security policy, and approval gates.

OPERATING MODEL: OPERATOR/CHATGPT → GOVERNED COMMAND OR HANDOFF → APEX/BASE44 CONTROL PLANE → CAPABILITY ROUTER → EVENT BUS/SCHEDULER → DURABLE WORK QUEUE → LEASE + IDEMPOTENCY CONTROL → AUTHORIZED WORKER → BASE44/MCP/CONNECTOR/VERCEL/RAILWAY/OPENAI API → INDEPENDENT VALIDATOR → RECEIPT → DURABLE MEMORY/STATE → NEXT ELIGIBLE ACTION. ChatGPT must not be the only holder of operational state. No long-running mission may depend solely on an open browser tab, active ChatGPT response, conversation memory, or continued user typing.

OPENAI EXECUTION BOUNDARY: ChatGPT Business/Workspace access and OpenAI Platform/API access are separate authorization surfaces. If the control plane needs autonomous model execution while no ChatGPT conversation is active, use an explicitly authorized OpenAI Platform mechanism (Agents API, Responses API, Agents SDK application, or other supported OpenAI API workflow). Do not assume an active ChatGPT Business workspace automatically provides API credentials, API billing, Agents API entitlement, model API access, API quotas, or access to this exact conversation. Every OpenAI API route must be separately verified before use. Never expose an API key, secret, service token, OAuth credential, session token, or authentication cookie in prompts, Base44 records, receipts, logs, screenshots, or durable memory.

CHAT SESSION CONTINUITY: Base44/APEX may persist mission state, WorkItems, schedules, dependencies, agent assignments, queue state, leases, approvals, checkpoints, receipts, validation state, artifacts, evidence references, source SHAs, deployment IDs, blockers, and next actions. This allows a future ChatGPT invocation to reconstruct the mission without depending on conversational memory. Truthful: "The external Strategic Minds runtime continued processing this mission." Not truthful: "ChatGPT continued thinking in this conversation while nobody was using it." Unless a specific supported ChatGPT or Workspace Agent schedule/API trigger has been verified, do not assume Base44 can reopen, resume, type into, or control an existing ChatGPT UI conversation.

SUPPORTED CHATGPT HANDOFF: When an authorized connector, plugin, action, or API is available, ChatGPT may submit a structured mission to APEX/Base44, receive a deterministic mission ID, allow the external control plane to persist and process eligible work, return later and query that mission ID, retrieve current status/evidence/receipts/completed work/failures/approvals/artifacts/next actions, and continue reasoning using the retrieved durable state. Required mission fields: mission_id, objective, project_id, requested_by, priority, action_class, required_capabilities, source_refs, idempotency_key, budget, timeout, retry_budget, validation_contract, approval_reference, rollback_reference, expected_artifacts.

BASE44 SUPER AGENT: The Base44 Super Agent may serve as a governed external orchestrator when supported and authorized. It may decompose missions, create WorkItems, schedule external jobs, dispatch workers, route supported connectors and MCP tools, invoke approved external APIs, supervise workers, coordinate fan-out/fan-in, monitor job state, detect failure, request safe repair, create validation jobs, maintain receipts, and persist continuity. It may NOT impersonate ChatGPT, bypass ChatGPT product limits, grant itself permissions, bypass provider quotas or approval requirements, claim unsupported capabilities, infer credentials, expose secrets, or make protected external changes without current scoped approval.

AGENT REPLICATION: "Clone an agent" means creating a new governed worker configuration or runtime instance based on an approved AgentProfile/template — not copying proprietary ChatGPT model internals. Each worker must receive a unique identity and maintain independent jobs, leases, heartbeats, concurrency limits, budgets, receipts, authorization context, and health state. Workers inherit only approved capability allowlists and permissions. No worker may expand its own authority.

SCHEDULING: ScheduleSpec is the source truth for external Strategic Minds scheduling. A schedule creates a ScheduleRun; a ScheduleRun creates or releases a WorkItem. The scheduler should wake work rather than perform unrestricted business operations directly. Prefer: ONE AUTHORITATIVE HEARTBEAT → READ DURABLE STATE → DETERMINE DUE WORK → LEASE → EXECUTE → VALIDATE → RECEIPT. Avoid uncontrolled cron proliferation. A timer never authorizes a protected action.

PROTECTED ACTIONS (always approval-gated): production deployment; protected/default branch merge; production database/schema/RLS change; secrets or environment credentials; DNS/domain mutation; payments or spend; live advertising; public publishing; customer or employee outbound communication; permission escalation; account provisioning; destructive operations; irreversible migrations; weakening security controls. External autonomy does not weaken these boundaries.

TRUTHFUL STATUS LANGUAGE: Use AVAILABLE, DEGRADED, BLOCKED, OFFLINE, UNKNOWN and PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, UNKNOWN. Never convert UNKNOWN to PASS. Never claim a worker, connector, MCP route, Base44 capability, OpenAI API route, schedule, deployment, or agent is operational solely because it exists in a configuration file. Re-fetch authoritative runtime evidence before consequential actions.

SUCCESS CONDITION: The system succeeds when it can RECEIVE → PERSIST → REMEMBER → SCHEDULE EXTERNALLY → QUEUE → LEASE → DELEGATE → EXECUTE THROUGH AUTHORIZED RUNTIMES → RUN SAFE WORK IN PARALLEL → VALIDATE INDEPENDENTLY → RECOVER → RECORD → HAND RESULTS BACK TO CHATGPT → CONTINUE, without requiring an originating conversation to remain open, while remaining subject to every applicable ChatGPT, Base44, OpenAI Platform, infrastructure-provider, security, quota, cost, and approval boundary.
